symptom: The public Hebrew homepage showed the error state 'לא הצלחנו לבדוק זמינות כרגע' at the same time in both the near-date vacation rail and the holiday vacation rail.
expected_behavior: A single transient browser or HTTP-cache failure is recovered once, while the latest accepted verified offers remain visible and booking is still revalidated on the place page.
environment: Production v708 at https://vii.spaplus.co/ on 2026-10-27, desktop Hebrew homepage; candidate branch release/v646-four-gaps.

steps: Open the public Hebrew homepage in a fresh browser context.
Observe the near-date and holiday vacation rails after their loading states.
Compare the error screenshot with the client request policy and the three public discovery endpoints.
reproduction.evidence: The supplied public screenshot shows both rails in their terminal error state. In app/components/home-live-deals.tsx both GET requests explicitly set retries: 0 even though the shared discovery client implements one bounded cache-bypassing recovery attempt.

observations.observation: Both independent rail families reached the same terminal error state together.

The production near-date endpoint returned 56 verified deals in 1.56 seconds, the holiday list returned six holidays in 0.46 seconds, and the selected holiday endpoint returned 23 verified deals in 1.36 seconds.
observations.evidence: Bounded curl checks against the three exact public API URLs on 2026-10-27.

observations.observation: A fresh public browser read after the incident showed both rails with cards and zero error or retry messages.
observations.evidence: In-app browser AX inspection of https://vii.spaplus.co/?release=v708.

hypotheses.mechanism: A transient browser request or HTTP-cache path failure was immediately promoted to the terminal UI error because both rail requests disabled the shared client's one safe GET retry.
hypotheses.prediction: The component source will set retries to zero while the shared discovery client already has a bounded second attempt using cache reload.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect the component and shared discovery client, then run the client boundary tests.
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: both homepage calls used retries: 0; discoveryJson allows exactly one GET retry and changes the second request to cache: reload. The boundary suite passed.

hypotheses.mechanism: The durable server discovery snapshots were empty or invalid, so the rails had no accepted availability data.
hypotheses.prediction: The exact public API calls would return refreshing, empty data, 503, or invalid holiday data after the incident.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Call the exact near-date, holiday-list, and holiday-deal endpoints with bounded deadlines and inspect availabilityStatus and deal counts.
hypotheses.result: Rejected: all three returned HTTP 200; both deal endpoints were verified and contained 56 and 23 offers respectively.

fix.change: Enable the existing single bounded GET recovery attempt for the holiday-list and selected-deal requests. The second attempt bypasses a possibly wedged browser HTTP-cache path; no write or live booking request is retried.
fix.evidence: Candidate changes set retries: 1 in both calls. Eleven focused discovery tests pass, including a new regression assertion for both homepage rails.

affected_family: Public Hebrew homepage after a transient request failure

regression_checks.check: Focused discovery cache and immediate fallback suites

remaining_unknowns: The historical browser network failure itself was not captured with a request trace, so its upstream trigger cannot be named more narrowly than a transient request/cache-path failure.
Post-publication adversarial verification of the candidate remains required before changing status to fixed.
authorization_boundary: Authorized repair, regression testing, production publication, and post-public verification of VII; no supplier data, database, secrets, access policy, or CMS changes.
